
## Functions

### hostAgentExtension()

```ts
function hostAgentExtension(rostered): HostedAgentExtension;
```

Serve one extension's prompt sections and tools to a remote Agent. Throws when
the extension requests a capability hosting does not provide yet, so a build
fails instead of silently dropping it.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                                       |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rostered` | [`RosteredExtensionV0`](extensions.md#rosteredextensionv0) |

#### Returns

[`HostedAgentExtension`](#hostedagentextension)
